usedFor: Process Street holds the checklists, and Sangam CRM receives a lead through “Create or Update Lead” after “Workflow Run Completed”.

bestTemplate.name: “Workflow Run Completed” in Process Street, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: A completed run is a finished intake, and the lead is found or updated by ID, email or phone.

watchOut: “Data Set Record Created” and “Data Set Record Updated” are polling, so those leads arrive after a scheduled check.
